profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Breakthrough Technologies
profile.summary: Lead engineer with approximately 20 years of experience, capable of serving as a lead developer or project architect and versed in all areas of the SDLC. Excellent development and communications skills are part of my skillset, and I am consistently rated as exceeding expectations. I have a passion for my work, constantly try to improve my skillset and stay current, and stay active in local communities.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Breakthrough Technologies provides me the opportunities to:
• Define organization best practices for developing Drupal projects including Behat test implementations, virtual machine setup, Git workflows and code reviews, and deployment strategies.
• Lead the Drupal teams involved in building the front-end applications for rostering students and administering assessments for Breakthrough’s line of assessment delivery products.
Built a reusable SSO SAML Drupal module that takes advantage of the OneLogin toolkit allowing Drupal to act as a Service Provider (https://github.com/Breakthrough-Technologies/bt_onelogin_saml).

Brought on as Senior developer to work on Java project developing bookshelf and book reader applications, and to help with Breakthrough’s Drupal projects 
•	Helped document the architecture, data model, and technologies used for client’s library set of applications.
•	Acted as a remote pair programmer with client to complete agile stories and bugs using TDD, Mockito, Struts 2.0, JWS, EJB 3.0, and Hibernate.
•	Provided high level project architecture plans for Drupal sales proposals, and trusted by the Sales team to present plans to potential clients.
•	Brought in a past client of mine to work on their JavaScript flight tracker tool and new Drupal website.
•	Mentored developers on building a Village District website with Drupal.
•	One of two architects contracted to define the high level components, interoperability requirements, deployment goals, and technical architecture of an open source K-12 assessment solution designed to meet the needs of students with the most significant cognitive disabilities.
•	Lead developer role in building a complex Accreditation Management System taking advantage of the State Machine contrib module for workflow integrations, Migrate for migrating content of legacy AMS, and custom modules to integrate with Rules, the Message stack of modules, and provide RESTful communication to 3rd party payment system.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Develop infrastructure and backend technologies for professional athlete websites including Lamar Odom (www.lamarodom.com), Jason Kidd (www.jasonkidd.com), Josh Howard(www.joshhoward.com), and more
